name: aeroinsight
description: AeroInsight is a full-stack web application designed for drone telemetry analysis. It integrates a Node.js/Express backend, an SQLite database for log storage, a React/Vite frontend with dynamic mapping via Leaflet, and AI-powered anomaly detection using the Google Gemini API.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
